name: Watcher
description: a floating stone eyeball: a big round pale grey stone eyeball floating in the air by itself, a single glowing cyan iris and pupil, a heavy carved stone eyelid over its top half, a ring of small floating rune stones orbiting it, a faint cyan glow

poses.stand: floating in the air, the stone lid open, the cyan eye staring to the right
poses.struck: the stone lid slammed shut, cracked
poses.dead: cracking apart into stone pieces and fading cyan dust
poses.shut: the same eye with its heavy carved stone eyelid closed over it, only a thin cyan line of light showing

idle.action: floats with its heavy stone eyelid shut, bobbing, the rune stones orbiting slowly

attack.action: stares wide open, the cyan iris flaring bright again and again as bolts of cyan light shoot out of the pupil to the right

hurt.action: is struck, the eye jolts back and squints, cracks of cyan light flash on the stone, then it steadies

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

style: Painterly digital painting in the style of dark fantasy video game art: soft visible brush strokes, rich shading, gritty and detailed, warm hellfire rim light, high resolution and smooth (not pixel art, not a cartoon).

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it, the whole thing visible. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}
